definition: a soft white plant fiber used to make cloth
description: On a narrow stone staircase between old walls in warm sunlight, a smiling young man in a white shirt stands on the steps and tosses a long roll of thin white fabric, which unrolls and billows down the stairs in soft waves while he holds the roll. Rolls of the same white cloth are stacked along both walls. A woman and two men stand against the wall, the woman raising her hands and cheering, and an older woman in a patterned sari watches from a doorway.
